## State Properties

State properties are things like temperature and pressure, $P$.

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
Intensive and extensive properties...
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## 📘 Key Term
**Gibbs Energy** ($G$) — a thermodynamic state function defined as $G = H - TS$.
:::

::: {.content-visible when-format="revealjs"}
**Intensive vs Extensive Properties:**

- **Intensive:** Size independent, e.g. temperature, density
- **Extensive:** Size dependent, e.g. volume
:::
